## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Wait until the queued policy change timelock delay has elapsed before calling policy_execute_asset.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let admin = Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_init(&admin);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_propose_asset(&f.token, &false);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_policy_execute_asset(&f.token));
```
